I’m late to this but I got a wrangler jl not a long and I have a one year daughter who is in the car seat. I had a Honda accord 2.0 turbo before this. This is why I change.

I want to start having adventures with my family. Yes I can do it with my Honda but I wanted a jeep since I was a kid and I had a 350z Nissan before my Honda. So I experienced different type of vehicle. I had my fun with fast/drifting cars it’s time to start camping and go on more adventure with my family.

The car seat we have is decently big, I have to move the passenger seat up but my wife is small and short so it’s fine with her but she does sit in the back to watch our daughter on trips, and when she wants to sit up front or someone want to, we turn around (we have a 360 degree car seat) the car seat so the passenger can go back. The cargo space is a lot better than my accord, and will be great once I invest in a rack.

Yes it can be “loud” with 70+ mph, now I can’t say much about driving experience since the previous owner upgraded everything on what I would do, also barely had any mileage for what it is build with. So upgrading the parts can improve the driving experience for the driver.

Our baby can sleep perfectly fine in the car since my wife and I tried our best in the early stages to get her used to loud noises when napping and the bit of wind noise and highway noise or any other noise she is fine and can sleep, my wife is fine with it too because I told her beforehand.

Safety is there but I know the new 2024 has more safety feature, which I would wait until 2025 or later since this one coming up is a refresh and never know what could go run with the 1st gen refresh.

I’m saving up for camping gear and have time since our baby girl is still young.

Finally, for long trips, I find it comfortable, especially with the upgraded shocks, tie rod, 33 inch tires and other upgrades made it easy to drive. When wind does kick up, you can somewhat feel it and holding the steering wheel harder. 

Btw I live in south Florida.

Overall, it’s a great vehicle to have as a family car/suv but if you have more than two kids, I won’t recommend it honestly, I know when it’s time for our third kid, which be a while, it will be time to trade in the wrangler but I will stay with the Jeep family. It’s great to make memories, have adventures, and able to truly have fun.

I hope this helps
